fact_check_verdict: single-source feature: ADN is the only outlet for every project; quote fragments verified; symposium dates from a second listing; no primary documents reached. Hedged language only.

claims.spoken: Jan Ronner, a former U A A alpine racer, is building FlowLine.
requires: ADN only. Say building, never live. No users or accuracy figure is reported.

claims.spoken: Ronner plans to launch in December.
requires: Ronner's plan per ADN. Never say launched.

claims.spoken: Online advice, Ronner said, is very generic.
requires: Quote fragment confirmed on ADN and Yahoo ('very generic and not very personalized'). Attribute to Ronner.

claims.spoken: FlowLine is an A I app that grades a skier's uploaded video and suggests drills.
requires: ADN description. No method, accuracy or user figure is reported, so the film never shows a score.

claims.spoken: Nathan Healy presented ANCHOR, built to help older Alaskans stay independent.
requires: ADN says Healy presented ANCHOR. Do not say deployed, piloted or sold, and do not give Healy a role.

claims.spoken: Motion sensors and one button learn a senior's routines.
requires: Wording from the ADN text as syndicated by Yahoo, paraphrase. Do not name routine types.

claims.spoken: It's designed to alert family when a routine slips past a safety threshold.
requires: Keep 'designed to'. Never draw an alert that has happened to a person.

claims.spoken: Graduate student Aaron Smith uses digital twins, virtual copies of real equipment, to model compressors for a proposed gas pipeline.
claims.on_screen: AARON SMITH · DIGITAL TWINS OF COMPRESSORS · PER ADN
requires: ADN ties it to the proposed pipeline. Never say the pipeline's developer uses or approved his work.

claims.spoken: Smith calls the compressor that pipeline's heartbeat.
claims.on_screen: "THE HEARTBEAT OF THAT PIPELINE" · AARON SMITH
requires: Quote confirmed on ADN and Yahoo. Attribute to Smith.

claims.spoken: The Daily News reports an estimate of more than fifty four billion dollars for the pipeline.
requires: ADN only, estimator not named. Always estimated and per ADN.

claims.spoken: Three University of Alaska projects were shown at a statewide A I symposium.
requires: Dates from the Alaska Business listing, not ADN.

claims.spoken: That Daily News story, the only report found, names no users, no accuracy figures and no pilots.
requires: True of the ADN text the validator read: no users, accuracy figure, pilot or deployment is reported. 'The only one' means the only story the research found, say 'that story'. A statement about the record, not about the projects.

claims.spoken: These are showcase projects, so early is fair. Proof would be a December start that holds, a first household for ANCHOR, and a twin checked against a real compressor.
requires: The film's own framing, labelled as such on screen. Not a claim that any of these will happen.

claims.spoken: Press a blob against a boot, and it remembers the boot. Norm is a blob standing in for a machine that learns normal.
claims.on_screen: NORM · A STAND-IN FOR A MACHINE THAT LEARNS NORMAL
requires: A labelled metaphor. The film never says FlowLine or the twin flags departures. Only ANCHOR is described as alerting.
